annotation.title_clean: Regulation (EU) 2024/… of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.title_en: Regulation (EU) 2024/… of the European Parliament and of the Council laying down harmonised rules on artificial intelligence (Artificial Intelligence Act)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: European Parliament and Council of the European Union
annotation.venue: Official Journal of the European Union (PE-CONS 24/1/24 REV 1)
named_instruments_referenced: EU Civil Law Rules on Robotics 2017
annotation.summary_en: The EU Artificial Intelligence Act (adopted 13 June 2024) sets harmonised, risk-based rules for AI systems and general-purpose AI models. It bans certain practices, imposes requirements on high-risk systems including AI safety components in regulated products such as machinery, vehicles and medical devices, and creates conformity assessment, sandboxes, and AI Office governance.
key_provisions_or_claims: Prohibits manipulative AI, social scoring, untargeted facial scraping, workplace emotion recognition and most real-time remote biometric ID for law enforcement.
High-risk classification covers AI safety components of products under Annex I harmonisation law (machinery, medical devices, vehicles) and Annex III use cases.
High-risk systems need risk management, data governance, documentation, human oversight, accuracy, robustness and cybersecurity.
Conformity assessment, CE marking, EU database registration and post-market monitoring with serious incident reporting.
General-purpose AI models with systemic risk face evaluation, incident reporting and cybersecurity duties under AI Office supervision.
